title: Disruptive Seeks $10B AI Fund to Back High Scale Startups
summary:
The Dallas-based venture firm Disruptive has already secured $7.5B for its newest round of capital raising. Founded in 2012, the firm is targeting a total of $10B for a late-stage fund to expand its portfolio of artificial intelligence investments following successful stakes in startups such as Groq and Reflection AI.

The raise aims to provide a level of financial support and patience for ambitious companies that partners say few other investors can match. Alex Davis leads the firm's strategy to deploy this capital at a scale necessary for high-growth AI ventures.
